scope: Linux SDK-hosted comparison of actual loaded VST3 baseline/current modules

environment.host_linkage: SDK hosting/loader archives only; no instrument code linked into host

inputs.gain_dense: At each sample f in each epoch: 0 if 1750 <= f < 1780, else (32+(13*f)%193)/256.
inputs.gain_sparse: Per callback, points at 0, floor(n/2) if n>2, n-1 if n>1; values from gain_dense at global epoch frame. Compare only identical partitions.
inputs.events_and_recall_schedule: Complete explicit notes, sustain and recall/flush schedule retained in reproduction.harness_source.
inputs.excluded: No CC123, polyphonic pressure, malformed input, resource saturation or native DAW/device trial.

source_fingerprints.note: Current sources are observed fingerprints; comparison results bind directly to recorded .so bytes.

reproduction.driver_source:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded comparison of independently loaded baseline/current VST3 bundles."""
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from hashlib import sha256
from itertools import product
from pathlib import Path
import json
import platform
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
WORK = ROOT / ".agent-work/worker033"
RAW = WORK / "raw"
RAW.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
BASE = ROOT.parent / "baseline/VST3"
CURRENT = ROOT / "build-host/VST3/Release"
SDK = Path("/workspace/scratch/d6370337c6a4/vst3sdk")
REV = "20a77e8b2033d435839df594c783837befb07938"
OUTPUT = ROOT / "docs/validation/host-midi-loaded-compatibility-20261124.json"
VARIANTS = ("RhodesResearch", "RhodesResearchFiltered", "RhodesResearchQuadrature")
FORMATS = (32, 64)
RATES = (48000, 192000)
PARTITIONS = ("whole", "fixed64", "ragged")
WORKLOADS = ("dense", "sparse")

def digest(data):
    return sha256(data).hexdigest()

def filehash(path):
    return digest(path.read_bytes())

def jsonhash(value):
    return digest(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode())

def command(args, cwd=ROOT):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)

def read_command(args, cwd=ROOT):
    process = command(args, cwd)
    if process.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{shlex.join(map(str,args))}: {process.stderr}")
    return process.stdout.strip()

def module_hashes():
    return {
        f"{version}/{variant}": {
            "path": str(directory / (variant+".vst3")),
            "module_sha256": filehash(directory / (variant+".vst3") / "Contents/x86_64-linux" / (variant+".so")),
            "moduleinfo_sha256": filehash(directory / (variant+".vst3") / "Contents/Resources/moduleinfo.json"),
        }
        for version,directory in (("baseline",BASE),("current",CURRENT))
        for variant in VARIANTS
    }

SOURCE_PATHS = [
    "CMakeLists.txt", "include/rhodes/audio_engine.hpp",
    "include/rhodes/audio_filter_coefficients.hpp", "include/rhodes/control_value.hpp",
    "include/rhodes/control_text.hpp", "include/rhodes/event_processor.hpp",
    "include/rhodes/fir_decimator.hpp", "include/rhodes/instrument_state.hpp",
    "include/rhodes/note_tracker.hpp", "include/rhodes/quadrature_engine.hpp",
    "include/rhodes/quadrature_filter_coefficients.hpp", "include/rhodes/quadrature_fir.hpp",
    "include/rhodes/research_engine.hpp", "src/research_engine.cpp",
    "plugins/vst3/controller.cpp", "plugins/vst3/controller.hpp",
    "plugins/vst3/factory.cpp", "plugins/vst3/plugin_ids.hpp",
    "plugins/vst3/processor.cpp", "plugins/vst3/processor.hpp",
    "plugins/vst3/state_stream.cpp", "plugins/vst3/state_stream.hpp",
    "docs/specs/HOST_MIDI_20261124.md",
]

def source_hashes():
    return {path:filehash(ROOT/path) for path in SOURCE_PATHS}

archives = [
    "build-host/librhodes_vst3_loader_support.a",
    "build-host/lib/Release/libsdk_hosting.a",
    "build-host/lib/Release/libsdk_common.a",
    "build-host/lib/Release/libbase.a",
    "build-host/lib/Release/libpluginterfaces.a",
]
compile_args = [
    "/usr/bin/c++", "-O3", "-DNDEBUG", "-std=gnu++20", "-Wall", "-Wextra",
    "-Wpedantic", "-Wconversion", "-Wshadow", "-Werror", "-DRELEASE=1",
    "-isystem", str(SDK), str(WORK/"loaded_compatibility.cpp"),
    "-o", str(WORK/"loaded_compatibility"), *archives, "-lstdc++fs", "-lpthread", "-ldl",
]
started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
source_before = source_hashes()
modules_before = module_hashes()
compiled = command(compile_args)
(WORK/"compile.log").write_text(
    "$ "+shlex.join(compile_args)+"\nexit_code="+str(compiled.returncode)+"\n"+
    compiled.stdout+compiled.stderr)
if compiled.returncode:
    raise RuntimeError("Harness build failed; see compile.log")

commands = []
runs = {}
def one(version, directory, variant, format_bits, rate, partition, workload):
    stem = f"{version}-{variant}-{format_bits}-{rate}-{partition}-{workload}"
    trace = RAW/(stem+".bin")
    stdout = RAW/(stem+".json")
    stderr = RAW/(stem+".stderr")
    args = [
        str(WORK/"loaded_compatibility"), str(directory/(variant+".vst3")),
        str(format_bits), str(rate), partition, workload, str(trace),
    ]
    run = command(args)
    stdout.write_text(run.stdout)
    stderr.write_text(run.stderr)
    record = {
        "command": shlex.join(args), "exit_code":run.returncode,
        "stdout_path":str(stdout.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "stderr_path":str(stderr.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "trace_path":str(trace.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "stdout_sha256":filehash(stdout), "stderr_sha256":filehash(stderr),
    }
    if run.returncode == 0:
        record["metadata"] = json.loads(run.stdout)
        record["audio_sha256"] = filehash(trace)
        record["audio_bytes"] = trace.stat().st_size
    return record

cases = []
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
    for variant,format_bits,rate,partition,workload in product(
            VARIANTS,FORMATS,RATES,PARTITIONS,WORKLOADS):
        key = (variant,format_bits,rate,partition,workload)
        futures = [
            pool.submit(one,version,directory,*key)
            for version,directory in (("baseline",BASE),("current",CURRENT))
        ]
        baseline,current = [future.result() for future in futures]
        for version,run in (("baseline",baseline),("current",current)):
            commands.append({k:v for k,v in run.items() if k != "metadata"})
            runs[(version,)+key] = run
        okay = baseline["exit_code"] == current["exit_code"] == 0
        case = {
            "variant":variant, "format_bits":format_bits, "sample_rate_hz":rate,
            "partition":partition, "gain_workload":workload,
            "baseline_exit":baseline["exit_code"], "current_exit":current["exit_code"],
        }
        if okay:
            left = dict(baseline["metadata"])
            right = dict(current["metadata"])
            count_pair = [left.pop("parameter_count"),right.pop("parameter_count")]
            audio_equal = ((ROOT/baseline["trace_path"]).read_bytes()
                           == (ROOT/current["trace_path"]).read_bytes())
            case.update({
                "parameter_counts":count_pair,
                "metadata_except_parameter_count_exact":left == right,
                "audio_stereo_bytes_exact":audio_equal,
                "audio_sha256":baseline["audio_sha256"],
                "current_audio_sha256":current["audio_sha256"],
                "callbacks_per_version":left["callbacks"],
                "output_frames_per_version":left["output_frames"],
                "state_checkpoints":len(left["checkpoints"]),
                "state_checkpoints_sha256":jsonhash(left["checkpoints"]),
                "latency_frames":left["latency"],
                "baseline_raw":baseline["stdout_path"],
                "current_raw":current["stdout_path"],
            })
            okay = (left == right and audio_equal and count_pair == [2,18])
        case["passed"] = okay
        cases.append(case)
        print(f"{'PASS' if okay else 'FAIL'} {variant} f{format_bits} {rate} {partition} {workload}",
              flush=True)

partition_results = []
for version,variant,format_bits,rate in product(("baseline","current"),VARIANTS,FORMATS,RATES):
    selected = [runs[(version,variant,format_bits,rate,p,"dense")] for p in PARTITIONS]
    okay = all(run["exit_code"] == 0 for run in selected)
    okay = okay and len({run["audio_sha256"] for run in selected}) == 1
    partition_results.append({
        "version":version,"variant":variant,"format_bits":format_bits,
        "sample_rate_hz":rate,"three_partitions_exact":okay,
    })

modules_after = module_hashes()
source_after = source_hashes()
unchanged = modules_before == modules_after and source_before == source_after
baseline_sources = {}
for path in SOURCE_PATHS:
    old = subprocess.run(["git","show",f"{REV}:{path}"],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,timeout=60)
    baseline_sources[path] = digest(old.stdout) if old.returncode == 0 else None
overall = all(case["passed"] for case in cases) and all(
    case["three_partitions_exact"] for case in partition_results) and unchanged
summary = {
    "passed":overall, "baseline_current_pairs":len(cases),
    "passed_pairs":sum(case["passed"] for case in cases),
    "loaded_processes":len(commands),
    "paired_stereo_frames":sum(case.get("output_frames_per_version",0) for case in cases),
    "loaded_callbacks_total":sum(run.get("metadata",{}).get("callbacks",0) for run in runs.values()),
    "paired_state_checkpoints":sum(case.get("state_checkpoints",0) for case in cases),
    "dense_partition_groups":len(partition_results),
    "dense_partition_groups_passed":sum(case["three_partitions_exact"] for case in partition_results),
    "modules_and_relevant_sources_unchanged_during_run":unchanged,
}
artifact = {
    "schema_version":1, "status":"passed" if overall else "failed",
    "started_utc":started,"completed_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "scope":"Linux SDK-hosted comparison of actual loaded VST3 baseline/current modules",
    "baseline_revision":REV, "observed_current_head":read_command(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]),
    "environment":{
        "platform":platform.platform(), "machine":platform.machine(),
        "compiler":read_command(["/usr/bin/c++","--version"]).splitlines()[0],
        "sdk_revision":read_command(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],SDK),
        "sdk_submodules":read_command(["git","submodule","status"],SDK).splitlines(),
        "host_linkage":"SDK hosting/loader archives only; no instrument code linked into host",
    },
    "inputs":{
        "formats_bits":list(FORMATS), "sample_rates_hz":list(RATES),
        "epoch_frames":2048, "epochs":2, "post_recall_silence_frames":128,
        "partitions":{"whole":[2048],"fixed64":[64],"ragged":[1,7,31,128,3,257,64,509,2,100]},
        "gain_dense":"At each sample f in each epoch: 0 if 1750 <= f < 1780, else (32+(13*f)%193)/256.",
        "gain_sparse":"Per callback, points at 0, floor(n/2) if n>2, n-1 if n>1; values from gain_dense at global epoch frame. Compare only identical partitions.",
        "events_and_recall_schedule":"Complete explicit notes, sustain and recall/flush schedule retained in reproduction.harness_source.",
        "excluded":"No CC123, polyphonic pressure, malformed input, resource saturation or native DAW/device trial.",
    },
    "modules":modules_before,
    "source_fingerprints":{
        "baseline_git_blob_contents_sha256":baseline_sources,
        "current_worktree_sha256":source_before,
        "loader_archives_sha256":{path:filehash(ROOT/path) for path in archives},
        "harness_sha256":filehash(WORK/"loaded_compatibility.cpp"),
        "driver_sha256":filehash(Path(__file__)),
        "harness_executable_sha256":filehash(WORK/"loaded_compatibility"),
        "note":"Current sources are observed fingerprints; comparison results bind directly to recorded .so bytes.",
    },
    "summary":summary, "cases":cases, "dense_partition_comparisons":partition_results,
    "reproduction":{
        "working_directory":str(ROOT),
        "command":"python3 .agent-work/worker033/run_comparison.py",
        "compile_command":shlex.join(compile_args),
        "compile_log":".agent-work/worker033/compile.log",
        "commands_log":".agent-work/worker033/commands.json",
        "raw_results_directory":".agent-work/worker033/raw",
        "raw_manifest_sha256":jsonhash(commands),
        "harness_source":(WORK/"loaded_compatibility.cpp").read_text(),
        "driver_source":Path(__file__).read_text(),
        "restore":"Write harness_source and driver_source into the stated .agent-work/worker033 paths; use matching bundle/SDK archive bytes and run the recorded command.",
    },
    "limitations":[
        "Baseline bundle provenance is supplied by the integrator; module hashes identify the actual tested binaries.",
        "Only the recorded legacy valid-input timelines, formats, rates and partitions were replayed.",
        "Sparse automation endpoints depend on callback size, so only dense automation claims partition invariance.",
        "This verifies before/after legacy compatibility, not an independent physical-model or numerical-accuracy oracle.",
        "No native DAW, device timing, operating-system portability, allocation, or thread-concurrency claim.",
    ],
}
(WORK/"commands.json").write_text(json.dumps(commands,indent=2)+"\n")
(WORK/"summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+"\n")
OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(artifact,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2),flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if overall else 1)
